metadata.methods_description: Non-invasive spinal cord recordings were obtained using three rings of electrodes positioned around the neck at the level of the sixth cervical vertebra. Electrodes were arranged in caudal, middle, and cranial rings, with the middle ring connecting points above the spinous process of C6 and the thyroid cartilage, and the caudal and cranial rings positioned approximately 2 cm below and above the middle ring, respectively. Subjects received electric median nerve stimulations on the left wrist preceded by auditory cues. The experimental design alternated between blocks with fixed (1100 ms) and variable (100-2100 ms) cue-to-stimulus intervals. Each subject completed two days of testing (except sub-24), with counterbalanced block order across subjects.
